text:
Jordan (AE): FYI - Orchid closed this AM. Quick operational brief so CS/Eng can take over. Key asks: private eval in their GCP account, Okta SSO, audit log retention, target ~100k tokens/day during pilot. Renewal at 9mo but procurement will re-evaluate if pilot drags >30d.

Priya (CSM): Thanks! I'll own onboarding cadence and weekly health check. Need an enablement checklist we can send to Sara (PM) & Tom (Infra).

Riley (Solutions Eng): I can draft a minimal infra checklist. Will include VPC peering details, firewall/IP allowlist, and cert install steps. Do we have expected peak qps and avg token size?

Jordan (AE): Sara estimated peak qps 8-12, avg ~60 tokens, bursty between 10am-3pm. Sending Sara/Tom contact now in DM.

Priya (CSM): Copying the short checklist I'll send to the customer:
```
- Provide GCP project ID + VPC CIDR
- Confirm egress IPs for allowlist
- Okta IdP metadata (XML) + test user
- Desired audit log retention (days)
- Expected session persistence (KV cache yes/no)
```
Send this in the onboarding email after Riley reviews.

Riley (Solutions Eng): LGTM. Also add: expected max sequence length and whether they want persistent KV cache. I'll attach a one-page runbook for peering and proxy fallback.

Ethan (Lead Support): I'll create two internal tickets: NETWORK-9876 for peering & certs, SSO-9877 for SAML setup. Assigning to infra oncall and eng-sso. Will link here. Initial triage within 8 business hours.

ops-bot: created NETWORK-9876: "Orchid - VPC peering & TLS certs" assigned to infra-oncall. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NETWORK-9876

ops-bot: created SSO-9877: "Orchid - Okta SAML setup" assigned to eng-sso. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SSO-9877

Aditi (AM): Flagging renewal-watch in CRM. If pilot hasn't started by day 21, I'll jump into procurement.

Priya (CSM): Action items (owners / deadlines):
- Priya: send onboarding email with checklist -> today EOD
- Riley: draft runbook + peering snippet -> Mon 10am PT
- Ethan: link internal tickets and post triage notes here -> within 8h
- Jordan: confirm commercial clause re: pilot milestones in contract -> done

Riley (Solutions Eng): Quick note: if CIDR overlaps we can offer a NAT/proxy solution but it adds ~3 business days. Call it out to customer to avoid surprise.

Priya (CSM): I'll include that as a potential blocker. Also starting weekly health syncs: Thu 10am PT for first 6 weeks.

Jordan (AE): Thanks team. Please tag me if procurement pops up.

Ethan (Lead Support): Will update NETWORK-9876 with first triage and request for customer's firewall rules.

Priya (CSM): I'll create the Confluence pilot feedback doc and post link after first sync. Keeping renewal-watch high. :exclamation:
